text: The rules. Turn each inequality into an equation with a slack variable, the unused capacity. Choose the pivot column with the most negative number in the Z row. Choose the pivot row with the smallest ratio of right side to column entry. Pivot, as in Gauss Jordan. Repeat until the Z row has no negatives.
